details.publicNotes:
A phasmogorgia is a massive fungus whose features evoke bloody flesh and hollow graves. It lords over ancient battlefields and forgotten cemeteries, where it digests the spirits of the dead. It ensnares spirits with a haze of ectoplasmic ambrosia, clouding their minds with bliss while it slowly devours them. When beings with souls approach a phasmogorgia, it eagerly hunts them, using its soul-ensnaring hooks to hasten their demise, together with ghost bombs made from partially digested spirits.

Too Hungry to Share

The concentration of spiritual energy within a phasmogorgia grants the fungus malevolent intelligence. This buffet of souls attracts like-minded individuals, such as demons, daemons, and mortal necromancers. While some phasmogorgias cooperate with other soul hunters, they quickly attack allies who take more than they give.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 375/840/1,560 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning), armor (light), perception item, skill items (Athletics, Lore [Spirit], Nature)

Eligible Imbued Properties body, bane, constitution, death, energy resistant (vitality), force, spirit, strength, throwing, wild, wisdom

description.value: The phasmogorgia senses the spirits of creatures, including living creatures, most non-mindless undead, and haunts within the listed range. As spiritsense detects spiritual essence, not physical bodies, it can detect spirits projected by spells such as project image or possessing otherwise soulless objects. It can't detect soulless bodies, constructs, or objects, and like most senses, it doesn't penetrate through solid objects.

40 feet. The phasmogorgia releases a constant haze of mystical spores that enraptures creatures, bringing them one step closer to death. When a creature with a soul starts its turn within is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:30] save. A creature that succeeds at the save is temporarily immune to Ectoplasmic Ambrosia for 24 hours. Spirits that fail the Will save are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the phasmogorgia for 1 minute and can't willingly move away from it while they remain fascinated. If the phasmogorgia takes a hostile action against a spirit or any of its allies, the spirit can attempt a new saving throw to end the fascination at the start of its next turn. If a doomed creature dies within the aura, its soul is bound to the phasmogorgia, and it can't be resurrected until the phasmogorgia is slain.

Frequency once per day

Effect The phasmogorgia digests captive spirits to rejuvenate itself, restoring @Damage[100[healing]] Hit Points. All creatures stunned by Soul Snatch and spirits @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by Ectoplasmic Ambrosia take @Damage[5d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic] save).

The phasmogorgia latches an ethereal hook to the soul of a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. Creatures with no soul automatically critically succeed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target's soul is shunted out of its body, stunning it for 1 round. While stunned in this way, the creature takes @Damage[2d8[force]] damage every time the phasmogorgia uses a ghost bomb Strike, as it includes the creature's soul in the projectile.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is stunned for 3 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to end the effect.

A swarm of spirits surges out of the phasmogorgia, dealing @Damage[5d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:40] (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic] save). A creature that fails the save is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).
